verdict: A sharp week-over-week pullback has stalled lead flow heading into heating season.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 16 leads at $98.87 cost per lead on $1,581.97 in total spend — but the final 7 days tell a harder story: leads dropped 75% and spend fell 43% week-over-week, pushing cost per lead up 130% as campaign activity thinned out during the stretch when heating demand is climbing. Google ads effectively paused on October 14th, and your Google Business Profile actions went to zero for five consecutive days, compounding the slowdown. We are resolving the campaign throttle, restoring active spend, and clearing a backlog of overdue deliverables — including heating campaigns, fall creative, and LSA re-enablement — that are directly blocking volume. You should see lead flow recover as those items go live over the next two weeks, timed to capture peak heating-season demand.
